_comment: AUTHORITATIVE server inventory for pgAdmin on dev-cluster.
PGADMIN_REPLACE_SERVERS_ON_STARTUP=True means this file is re-imported with
--replace on every pod start, so servers added through the UI are dropped on
the next restart. Add a server by editing this file: the configMapGenerator
hash changes, the Deployment rolls, and the new list loads.
Passwords come from PasswordExecCommand against the pgadmin-db-passwords
--replace drops the rows that saved passwords hang off.
sslmode prefer negotiates TLS with the CloudNativePG servers without
verifying it; verify-full would mean mounting each cluster's -ca Secret.
keycloak's Postgres serves no TLS at all.

1.Name: onyx-pg (CNPG 17)
1.Comment: CloudNativePG, 1 instance. Connects as the superuser.

2.Name: trellis-pg (CNPG 18)
2.Comment: CloudNativePG, 1 instance. No superuser secret exists; this is the app role that owns the database.

3.Name: keycloak (plain 17)
3.Comment: Plain Deployment, not operator-managed. No server TLS.
